newsitem.title: HONDURAS: Italy, France to forgive some Honduras debt.
newsitem.headline: Italy, France to forgive some Honduras debt.

text.p: Honduras will sign an agreement to have part of its outstanding debt with Italy and France forgiven in the coming weeks, a senior finance ministry official said on Wednesday.
Honduras plans to sign an accord sometime next week to pardon some $6 million in interest payments owed to Italy, said Orlando Garner, head of debt at the Finance Ministry.
He said the agreement will be signed in Honduras.
"It is an important amount of money, about some $6 million (with Italy) just in interest payments from the Paris Club III," told reporters.
At the same time, Honduras will sign a new debt agreement with Italy to borrow some $10 million to fund widening a hydroelectric dam in southern Honduras.
Honduras plans to follow that up with an agreement sometime in June with France to forgive some $8 million in outstanding debt payments.
Honduras' Paris Club III debt accord in 1995 restructured bilateral debt with Denmark, Germany, United States, Canada and Japan. An agreement with Italy and France had been pending.
